systems_page.lead: How I pair technical API automation with progressive team enablement so complex organizations actually ship faster.

cases.title: Family Sync & The 2.9x Asana Intake OS
cases.p1_html: When we migrated 50 marketers and creatives across BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift from Jira to Asana, downstream designers and web publishers were losing Figma links and copy docs across subtasks. Vendor reps told us native cross-level asset syncing was impossible without expensive third-party middleware.
cases.p2_html: I sat down with Claude Code and the Asana v3 Node.js SDK and built Family Sync: an idempotent dependency engine that automatically propagates Final Figma Links, Final Copy Docs, and Final Image Assets across parent and sibling subtasks, handles clear-keyword resets, and fires blocked-status alerts. Paired with a live 33-person automation keynote and the revived mTalks series, quarterly deliverable throughput climbed 2.9x (419 to 1,213), brief compliance jumped from 0% to 39% in 30 days, escalations dropped from 14.5% to 9.0%, and median cycle time compressed from ~30 to ~22 days.

cases.title: Launching Gartner MQ in 72 Hours & BigCommerce Payments
cases.p1_html: For the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant, I pre-staged icebox tickets in August and architected a Claude contingency plan on September 2. When Gartner unexpectedly dropped the report two weeks early on October 19, our pre-staged system and Family Sync automation let us launch the full executive landing page in 3 days with zero fire drills.
cases.p2_html: For BigCommerce Payments (launched on time April 3, 2026), I partnered with the Product Manager to run the AMER and EMEA marketing-moment launches across all shared-services teams, earning a thank-you by name from CEO Travis Hess in the company-wide launch note. I also drove the 2026 Commerce Awards program to 296 submissions (~99% of goal, +29% YoY).

cases.title: Global Release QA at Apple TV+ & Commercial Systems at CreatorIQ
cases.p1_html: At Apple (via TEKsystems), I directed high-volume static and motion creative pipelines and co-architected the standardized release QA review framework for Apple TV+ and Apple Music across hundreds of monthly global deliverables. Concurrently, through my studio, I scoped and delivered five-figure enterprise B2B commercial video engagements for CreatorIQ.

experiments_page.lead: I run a zero-API-cost, 4-accelerator local AI operating system across three physical machines (64 GB pooled VRAM and unified memory, 150 GB system RAM, and 1.13M+ indexed documents).

items.title: GroupThink: The 3-Body Neurobiological OS
items.p1_html: Instead of burning cloud tokens on polling loops, three peer nodes share one Git codebase with edge Neurons (zero-LLM collectors), a hash-filtered Synapse delta ledger, and a 3-stage Council synthesis engine.
items.p2_html:
Body 1 (ARTROCK Studio Forge): Left Hemisphere runs a KV-pinned 27B reasoning model on an RTX 3090 Ti (24 GB) for analytical synthesis; Right Hemisphere runs a 9B vision model on an RTX 5070 eGPU (12 GB) for 5-candidate photography grading.
Body 2 (Starlight Edit Bay): Apple M5 MacBook Air (24 GB unified) running MLX 9B for iMessage subtext and two-way Apple Reminders sync, automatically yielding when Premiere or DaVinci Resolve launches.
Body 3 (Midnight Watchdog): Linux server + RX 550 running 1.7B + Nomic embeddings, Home Assistant VM, and cloud telemetry pollers.

items.title: APPA: Autonomous Post-Production Pipeline
items.p1_html: As credited Producer on Ben Windle Shoots His Shot (@BenWindleShootsHisShot), I built APPA to eliminate a 15-to-20-hour weekly manual logging and rough-cut bottleneck. APPA ingests raw multi-camera field footage, runs WhisperX speaker-verified transcription and computer-vision scene grading, and compiles frame-accurate 24fps .fcpxml, .otio, and burnt-in 2-lane review proxies for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

items.title: Clarity: Zero-Assumption Socratic Voice Partner
items.p1_html: Triggered straight from the iPhone Action Button, Clarity pairs 4-tier semantic word-weighting with dynamic retrieval across SQLite, Meilisearch, and BookStack, responding in sub-second local Kokoro TTS while logging every verified turn into a QLoRA golden training dataset.
